line_infantry.name: Line Infantry
line_infantry.job: The backbone. Steady volleys, forms square against horse.

skirmishers.name: Skirmishers
skirmishers.job: Outrange the line and barely notice roundshot. Collapse if anything reaches them.

militia.name: Militia
militia.job: Cheap bodies to soak a first volley. Rout at the first hard knock.

sharpshooters.name: Sharpshooters
sharpshooters.job: Very long range. Pick off gunners and officers before anyone else.

zouaves.name: Zouaves
zouaves.field: 6 veterans in fezzes and baggy trousers
zouaves.job: Highest morale in the game. One volley, then in with the bayonet.

scouts.name: Scouts
scouts.job: Fast. Hunt skirmishers, unguarded guns and anything already running.

dragoons.name: Dragoons
dragoons.job: Ride up, dismount when the enemy is in carbine range, and hold. Remount when it is quiet.

heavy_cavalry.name: Heavy Cavalry
heavy_cavalry.job: The charge breaks any infantry not in square.

field_gun.name: Field Gun
field_gun.job: Roundshot bounces through every rank in its path. Switches to canister at close range.

horse_artillery.name: Horse Artillery
horse_artillery.job: Limbers up and follows the advance instead of sitting still.

gatling_gun.name: Gatling Gun
gatling_gun.job: A steady stream of fire with no reload window. Jams if it fires for too long.

howitzer.name: Howitzer
howitzer.job: Lobs shells that burst over an area. Slow to reload, useless up close.

fire.name: Fire!
fire.job: It fires at once, skipping its reload, and as hard as its first volley. Clears a jammed Gatling.

rally.name: Rally
rally.job: Stops a rout and restores nerve to everyone inside.

grand_battery.name: Grand Battery
grand_battery.job: An off-map bombardment. It can be dodged, so it is best on squares, guns and structures.

earthworks.name: Earthworks
earthworks.job: Halves musket fire on your troops behind it. Does nothing against shells.

balloon.name: Balloon
balloon.job: Your guns and battery on that flank fire a quarter further.

general.name: General
general.job: Regiments near him hold their nerve and reload faster. If he falls, they take a shock.

conscripts.name: Conscripts
conscripts.job: The cheapest bodies on the field. Something to soak a volley or block a charge for a moment.

voltigeurs.name: Voltigeurs
voltigeurs.job: Quick on their feet and in loose order. Harass, then get out of the way.

riflemen.name: Riflemen
riflemen.job: Rifles reach further than muskets. Loose order shrugs off cannon.

pioneers.name: Pioneers
pioneers.job: They ignore the fighting and make for the nearest work. When they reach it, it goes up.

cossacks.name: Cossacks
cossacks.job: Cheap and fast. They ride down anything that is already running.

drummer_boy.name: Drummer Boy
drummer_boy.field: A drummer beating the quick step
drummer_boy.job: Regiments near him march a quarter faster and hold a little steadier.

coehorn_mortar.name: Coehorn Mortar
coehorn_mortar.field: A little mortar two men can carry
coehorn_mortar.job: Lobs a small shell. Cheap, short-ranged, useless up close.

supply_wagon.name: Supply Wagon
supply_wagon.field: A wagon of powder and shot
supply_wagon.job: Brings a point of Powder every 10 seconds, four times.

abatis.name: Abatis
abatis.job: Horses cannot charge through it. Cavalry crossing it are slowed and cut up.

forced_march.name: Forced March
forced_march.field: Your regiments in a small circle
forced_march.job: They move half again as fast for six seconds.

hold_the_line.name: Hold the Line!
hold_the_line.field: Your regiments in a small circle
hold_the_line.job: For ten seconds nothing makes them run, and they steady a little.

grenadiers.name: Grenadiers
grenadiers.job: Their grenades burst among whoever stands next to the regiment they hit.

hussars.name: Hussars
hussars.job: Fast and fierce. They hunt down guns, skirmishers and anything running.

lancers.name: Lancers
lancers.job: A lance reaches into a square: a charge still does half its harm.

mountain_howitzer.name: Mountain Howitzer
mountain_howitzer.field: A light howitzer on a mule team
mountain_howitzer.job: Follows the advance like horse artillery, and lobs shells.

rifled_gun.name: Rifled Gun
rifled_gun.job: Outranges every other gun and hits works hard. No canister for close work.

field_hospital.name: Field Hospital
field_hospital.job: Your regiments within reach slowly get their men back.

volley_fire.name: Volley Fire!
volley_fire.field: Your regiments in a small circle
volley_fire.job: Every one of them fires at once, as hard as a first volley.

bugle_call.name: Bugle Call
bugle_call.job: They are ready to charge at once, and ride faster for three seconds.

highland_piper.name: Highland Piper
highland_piper.field: A piper in a feather bonnet
highland_piper.job: Regiments near him hold their nerve and get it back quickly.

rocket_troop.name: Rocket Troop
rocket_troop.job: Rockets land roughly where they are aimed and terrify horses.

siege_gun.name: Siege Gun
siege_gun.job: Made for knocking down works: it fires at them first, and hits them three times as hard.

torpedo.name: Torpedo
torpedo.job: Hidden from the enemy. It goes off under the first regiment to walk over it.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.job: They appear wherever you choose, even behind the enemy, but not right next to a work.

recruiting_depot.name: Recruiting Depot
recruiting_depot.field: A tent and a recruiting sergeant
recruiting_depot.job: Sends out a company of conscripts at once and every 9 seconds, four in all.

old_guard.name: Old Guard
old_guard.job: They never run. One volley, then in with the bayonet.

marshal.name: Marshal
marshal.job: A greater General: a wider circle, steadier men, faster reloads, quicker marching. One commander at a time.

great_mortar.name: Great Mortar
great_mortar.field: A huge mortar on a railway car
great_mortar.job: Reaches almost anywhere on the field with an enormous shell. Slow, and blind up close.

cuirassiers.name: Cuirassiers
cuirassiers.job: Their breastplates turn half of every musket ball. The heaviest charge there is.
